avoid_supplements.name: Potassium supplements
avoid_supplements.mechanism: ARBs reduce aldosterone, increasing potassium retention; concurrent supplementation significantly elevates hyperkalemia risk
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid potassium supplementation unless serum levels are documented low and approved by prescriber; monitor K+ levels regularly

avoid_supplements.name: NSAIDs (ibuprofen, naproxen)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: NSAIDs reduce renal perfusion and antagonize antihypertensive effect; combined use increases acute kidney injury and hyperkalemia risk
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid chronic NSAID use; prefer acetaminophen; if NSAID necessary, use lowest dose for shortest duration and monitor renal function

avoid_supplements.name: ACE inhibitors
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Dual RAAS blockade significantly increases hyperkalemia, hypotension, and acute renal failure risk
avoid_supplements.action: Do not combine ARBs with ACE inhibitors; choose one agent only

caution_supplements.name: Licorice root
caution_supplements.mechanism: Licorice may promote sodium retention and potassium depletion, potentially counteracting blood pressure benefits
caution_supplements.action: Limit consumption; monitor blood pressure response and electrolytes if used

caution_supplements.name: Garlic supplements
caution_supplements.mechanism: May have additive hypotensive effects, risk of excessive blood pressure lowering
caution_supplements.action: Monitor blood pressure; inform prescriber of use; assess for dizziness or orthostatic hypotension

caution_foods.name: High-potassium foods (bananas, spinach, beans, tomatoes, coconut water)
caution_foods.mechanism: ARBs increase potassium retention; excessive dietary potassium may contribute to hyperkalemia in susceptible patients
caution_foods.action: Consume in moderation; particularly cautious if renal function impaired; monitor serum potassium levels

caution_foods.name: Sodium-restricted diet
caution_foods.mechanism: While not contraindicated, excessive sodium restriction combined with ARBs may enhance hypotensive effect
caution_foods.action: Maintain moderate sodium intake per hypertension guidelines; avoid excessive restriction

monitoring_notes: Monitor serum potassium, creatinine, and BUN at baseline and regularly, especially in elderly patients or those with renal impairment. Assess for symptoms of hyperkalemia (weakness, palpitations) and hypotension (dizziness, syncope) at each visit.
